# ctrl+all

> Control Claude Code and Codex on your Mac from Android or iPhone. Share chats, approve requests, run project terminals, and schedule tasks. Free Mac app.

<!-- Keep in sync with /robots.txt and /ai.txt. Generated by site/build-md.py from index.html. -->

Free Mac app. Needs macOS 14.5 or later. Runs on Apple silicon and Intel. The hosted relay has a separate Pro subscription. The app runs the agent CLIs you already pay for on your own Mac and meters no tokens. Contact: support@ctrlall.app.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://ctrlall.app/index.md): Control coding agents on your Mac from Android or iPhone. Share chats with your team, approve requests, and run project terminals.
- [Run your own relay](https://ctrlall.app/byo-relay): what a self-hosted relay sees and how to connect an existing relay
- [Usage analytics](https://ctrlall.app/analytics): every usage event, its allowed properties, and the opt-out control
